description: Sets the panel colour used by the plugin's Magical CV theme, with CV control over each part of it

params.text: Multiplies the red, green and blue amounts together, setting the brightness of the colour, 0% to 100%
Sets the red in the colour, 0% for none and 100% for 255
Sets the green in the colour, 0% for none and 100% for 255
Sets the blue in the colour, 0% for none and 100% for 255

inputs.text: Modulates the red in the colour
Modulates the green in the colour
Modulates the blue in the colour

notes: the colour reaches only the DanTModules panels set to the Magical CV theme, which is chosen in each of those modules' own right-click menu under Theme
menu: Set as default keeps the current colour for new patches
CV Param Mode sets how every CV input acts on its knob: Offset adds the CV to it, Follow sets it from the CV, Attenuate scales the CV by it
CV Input Slew smooths every CV input, which stops abrupt CV changes flickering the colour: None, 1ms, 5ms, 10ms, 25ms, 50ms or 100ms
